name: Dimitrescu's Lewd Castle
source:
Rejoice, the story about many brave men attempting to take down the most dangerous vampire inside their village.

Will they be able to fulfill their sexual fantasies along the way? Or will they end up being enslaved like all previous visitors?

[From F95Zone]
translation:
欢呼吧！这是一段关于许多勇敢男子试图击败村中最危险吸血鬼的故事。

他们能否一路实现自己的性幻想？还是会像此前的访客一样，最终沦为奴隶？

[来源：F95Zone]
